notes.title: Fixed Japanese version download issue
notes.notes:
For who has downloaded the Japanese version, please try again to see if the empty file issue was fixed.
I am afraid it is because I didn’t check the setting on the Steam backend after adding the new language.
Sorry for my mistake and bringing the bad experience.
